languageModelTools.name: sas_list_libraries
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all SAS libraries available in the active SAS session. Use this to discover what data is available before writing SAS code.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List available SAS libraries in the current session.

languageModelTools.name: sas_list_tables
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all datasets and views in a SAS library. Use this to see what tables are available before referencing them in code.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List tables in a SAS library.

library.description: The SAS library name (libname), e.g. SASHELP or WORK.

languageModelTools.name: sas_describe_table
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the column names, types, and row count for a SAS dataset. Use this before writing PROC SQL, DATA steps, or any code that references specific columns.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Describe the columns and row count of a SAS dataset.

library.description: The SAS library name, e.g. SASHELP.

languageModelTools.name: sas_export_saspy_config
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Exports the active SAS connection profile as a saspy configuration for use with the sasquatch R package in Quarto documents. Use this when the user wants to create a Quarto document with SAS code or needs saspy setup. Save the output as sascfg_personal.py in the working directory (alongside the .qmd file) so the project is self-contained and deployable to Posit Connect. The sasquatch package (install.packages('sasquatch')) enables SAS code chunks in Quarto, and sasquatch::install_saspy() handles saspy installation.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Export the active SAS profile as a saspy configuration for Quarto/sasquatch.

file.description: The name of sas file to run

preamble.description: Specify the preamble SAS code that you want automatically inserted before running code.

postamble.description: Specify the postamble SAS code that you want automatically inserted after running code.

view/item/context.when: viewItem =~ /convertNotebookToFlow/ && view == serverdataprovider && SAS.connectionType != iom && SAS.connectionType != com

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run lint && npm run compile && npm run compile-browser
scripts.test: npm run test-server && npm run test-client
scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ..
